title: Addis Ababa Street Food Tour
localName: አዲስ አበባ ጎዳና ምግብ — Addis Street Tour
community: Addis Ababa — the capital and Africa's highest major city
author: Chef Haile
desc: Addis Ababa Street Food Tour — Street Chechebsa (ETH171), Sambusa (ETH161), Ful (ETH137), Multi-Layer Juice (ETH223), and Ethiopian Coffee (ETH212). The complete Addis Ababa street food experience — the African Union capital's extraordinary food culture from morning to night.
longDesc: Addis Ababa at 2,355 metres elevation is Africa's highest major city and its most extraordinary food destination — the convergence of all Ethiopian regional food traditions with modern urban innovation.
steps: Mid-morning: fresh juice at a juice bar.
chefTips: The Addis food day is organized by time — each meal has its moment.
commonMistakes: Combining everything at once — the sequence is the experience.
sustainabilityTips: Addis Ababa's street food uses entirely Ethiopian-sourced ingredients.
healthBenefits: The Addis day-food provides complete nutrition from dawn to dusk.
culturalNote: Addis Ababa is where all of Ethiopia's food traditions converge — the Tigrinya, the Oromo, the Gurage, the Harari, and the Somali-Ethiopian communities all contribute their food culture to the capital's extraordinary street food scene. To eat your way through Addis is to eat through Ethiopia itself.
